fingerprints.story: The salt air had a way of eating everything, from the iron railings to the bones of men, but it could not touch the silence inside Elias’s cottage. It was a heavy, suffocating silence, broken only by the rhythmic *thrum-thrum-thrum* of the great Fresnel lens rotating above and the distant, mournful cry of the gulls.
